descriptions.zh: 我们来自大洋深处，我们的物种完美地适应了深海环境下的生活。即使已经迈入星空，我们仍然没有忘记本源：水体是，也永远是我们的家园。如今，我们的飞升已经完成了——我们不再需要适应其他环境，而是改造其他的星球使其适应我们的需求。当新一天的黎明到来时，我们清楚再也没有什么东西可以让我们与海洋分离了。
descriptions.en: We came from the ocean, our species ideally suited to living in the depths of the seas. Even as we take to the stars, we have not abandoned our roots: the water is and shall always be our home. Now, our ascension is complete - no longer shall we adapt ourselves to living elsewhere rather than shaping worlds to suit our needs. As we greet the warmth of a new day, we know that nothing needs to take us from the ocean ever again.

label.zh: 这将是一个独一无二的家园。
label.en: It shall be a home like no other.

titles.zh: 发现冰封环境改造候选

descriptions.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详尽调查表明这颗行星拥有厚重冰层，因此可以转变为一颗怡人的海洋星球。我们只需将行星大幅度加热，并赋予它可以宜居的大气即可。

对这颗[From.GetPlanetMoon]进行环境改造在理论上是可行的，但我们目前所拥有的技术手段还不足以在有实际意义的时间框架内完成这一里程碑式的任务。
descriptions.en:
Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed a world with a sufficiently thick layer of ice that it could be restored into a pleasant ocean world, if rendered significantly warmer and bequeathed with a hospitable atmosphere.

Terraforming this [From.GetPlanetMoon] would theoretically be possible, but we do not yet possess the means to accomplish this monumental task within a realistic timeframe.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详尽调查表明这颗行星拥有厚重冰层，因此可以转变为一颗怡人的海洋星球。我们只需将行星大幅度加热，并赋予它可以宜居的大气即可。

巨大的能耗令人望而却步，但我们确实已经掌握了相关的技术手段，可以逐步将这颗[From.GetPlanetMoon]环境改造为可以再度支持生命的星球了。
descriptions.en:
Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed a world with a sufficiently thick layer of ice that it could be restored into a pleasant ocean world, if rendered significantly warmer and bequeathed with a hospitable atmosphere.

The energy costs would be daunting, but we do have the means to gradually terraform this [From.GetPlanetMoon] into something that would support life once again.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经杀死了天龙！随着最后一颤，最后一声可怕的怒吼，这头野兽最后的生命力流失竭尽。它的尸体仍然完好无损——但这不会持续太久，因为我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]吵着要拿到它去做实验。

在[dragon_planet.GetName]上，气氛喜忧参半。尽管许多人为击败这个令人恐惧的怪物而欢欣鼓舞，但曾经持续存在的巨龙还是对[This.GetAdj]的心灵产生了深远的影响。从某种意义上说，杀死它就像杀死某个人的神。

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在可以期待一个未来，一个凭借能力可以企及任何目标，而无惧超自然力量的未来。
descriptions.en:
We have slain the sky dragon! With one last shudder, one last terrible roar of fury, the last of the beast's life force drained away. Its carcass remains intact - but not for long, as our [This.GetScientistPlural] clamor to get ahold of it.

On [dragon_planet.GetName], the mood is mixed. Though many rejoice in the defeat of this much-feared monster, the once constant presence of the dragon had a profound impact on the [This.GetAdj] psyche. In a way, killing it is akin to killing one's gods.

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] may now look forward to a future where they are capable of anything, where no fear of the supernatural may hold them back from that which they wish to achieve.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经杀死了天龙！随着最后一颤，最后一声可怕的怒吼，这头野兽最后的生命力流失竭尽。它的尸体仍然完好无损——但这不会持续太久，因为我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]吵着要拿到它去做实验。

在[dragon_planet.GetName]上，气氛喜忧参半。尽管许多人为击败这个令人恐惧的怪物而欢欣鼓舞，但曾经持续存在的巨龙还是对[This.GetAdj]的心灵产生了深远的影响。尽管我们很久以前就放弃了崇拜伪神，但这次行动在象征上更像是彻底地将其放逐。[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在可以期待一个未来，一个凭借能力可以企及任何目标，而无惧超自然力量的未来。
descriptions.en:
We have slain the sky dragon! With one last shudder, one last terrible roar of fury, the last of the beast's life force drained away. Its carcass remains intact - but not for long, as our [This.GetScientistPlural] clamor to get ahold of it.

On [dragon_planet.GetName], the mood is mixed. Though many rejoice in the defeat of this much-feared monster, the once constant presence of the dragon had a profound impact on the [This.GetAdj] psyche. Though we cast off our false gods long ago, this act is in some way akin to banishing them all over again. [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] may now look forward to a future where they are capable of anything, where no fear of the supernatural may hold them back from that which they wish to achieve.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经杀死了天龙！随着最后一颤，最后一声可怕的怒吼，这头野兽最后的生命力流失竭尽。它的尸体仍然完好无损——但这不会持续太久，因为我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]吵着要拿到它去做实验。

尽管我们的集体意识仔细斟酌过这一举措，但我们仍对此抱有复杂的感受。一方面，我们感到很满意，因为我们征服了死亡的威胁。另一方面，这条长久以来存在的巨龙我们已经……相当熟悉了。虽然我们不像其他太空文明一样，花费很多时间痴迷于那些“超自然”的失去，但在某种程度上，我们仍然会认为这样的行为好似亲手杀死了自己的神明。现在我们可以期待一个我们无所不能的未来，无论多么难以克服的困难都无法阻碍我们。
descriptions.en:
We have slain the sky dragon! With one last shudder, one last terrible roar of fury, the last of the beast's life force drained away. Its carcass remains intact - but not for long, as our [This.GetScientistPlural] clamor to get ahold of it.

As our collective consciousness considers the deed, we embrace mixed feelings. On the one hand, there is satisfaction: a grave threat has been conquered. On the other, the previously ever-present dragon had become... familiar. Though we have little time for the "supernatural" obsessions of other spacefaring civilizations, in a way, we might consider this act as akin to killing our god. We may now look forward to a future where we are capable of anything, where no obstacle no matter how seemingly insurmountable may constrain us.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经杀死了天龙！随着最后一颤，最后一声可怕的怒吼，这头野兽最后的生命力流失竭尽。它的尸体仍然完好无损——但这不会持续太久，因为我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]吵着要拿到它去做实验。

尽管我们的处理器进行了重新校准以评估这件壮举的后果，我们却惊讶地发现，我们需要投入相当数量的重构才能实现。曾经存在的龙对我们的编程有相当大的影响，有数十亿个纠错保障来抵消其行动的不可预测性，这将花费一些时间来清理。另一方面，随着这种强大的威胁被清除，我们现在可以期待一个未来，无论多么难以克服的困难，都无法阻碍我们。
descriptions.en:
We have slain the sky dragon! With one last shudder, one last terrible roar of fury, the last of the beast's life force drained away. Its carcass remains intact - but not for long, as our [This.GetScientistPlural] clamor to get ahold of it.

As our processors recalibrate themselves to account for the consequences of the deed, we find that we have a surprising amount of refactoring to do. The previously ever-present dragon has had a considerable impact on our programming, with billions of fail-safes to counter the unpredictability of its actions, one which will take some time to untangle. On the other hand, with this formidable threat lifted from us, we may now look forward to a future where we are capable of anything, where no obstacle no matter how seemingly insurmountable may constrain us.

descriptions.zh:
我们成功击杀[dragon_system.GetName]恒星系的守护龙！虽然那是一场艰苦的战斗，但它证明了我们舰队很强大。现在[dragon_planet.GetName]的居民将不得不同样地面对敌人，过去那条认为没有人能过越过的巨龙、那种他们可以安全地躲在龙背后的事情已经不复存在。

似乎龙的遗骸在我们的[This.GetScientistPlural]看来是名副其实的宝库，他们相信他们可以发现合成生产龙鳞的方法。
descriptions.en:
We have slain the Dragon Protector of the [dragon_system.GetName] system! Though it put up a tough fight, it proved no match for our mighty fleets. Now the denizens of [dragon_planet.GetName] will have to face their foes as equals, no longer safe in the knowledge that none can get past the dragon.

It appears that the body it left behind is a veritable treasure trove for our [This.GetScientistPlural], who believe they can find out a way to synthetically produce the dragon's scales.

label.zh: 让我们看看它的遗骸还藏了什么秘密。
label.en: Let's see what secrets its remains may yield.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]击杀了天龙！这一可怕的事实导致[dragon_planet.GetName]现在很容易被攻击。
descriptions.en: The [From.GetName] has vanquished the Sky Dragon! As a result of this terrible deed, [dragon_planet.GetName] is now vulnerable to attack.

options.script: name = aquatics.110.A

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 言出必行，我们的死灵法师已将[dragon_system.GetName]恒星系的天龙复活了！虽然结果有些不太相同——正如某些人预料中的将某物由死变活会发生的那样——现在它急切地等待我们的指令。
descriptions.en: True to their word, our necromancers have returned the Sky Dragon of the [dragon_system.GetName] system to life! Though a little rough around the edges - as one would expect from a being just brought back from the dead - it now eagerly awaits our commands.

descriptions.zh: 控制§Y天龙§!是我们长久以来的计划。为了兑现这一目标，我们的工蜂进行了特异性演化。虽然感染的途径仍需要适应，但我们已成为了天龙，天龙亦成为了我们。蜂巢整合了它的知识和经验，我们已经为面对其同族做了充足准备。
descriptions.en: Controlling the §YSky Dragon§! was always in our plans. Our drones were especially evolved to claim this prize. While the infestation process required some adaptation, we are now the Sky Dragon, and it is us. With its knowledge and experience integrated into the hive, we stand well prepared to meet any of its kin.

descriptions.zh: 被称为§Y天龙§!的生物已经由死灵机师协议进行优化。其冰冷的吐息已经低至1开尔文。复活的天龙现已受我方控制。
descriptions.en: The creature designated §YSky Dragon§! has been overhauled according to Mechromancy protocols. Its freezing exhalations now approach 1 degree Kelvin. The reanimated dragon is now under our control.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 时光飞逝，我亦疑虑。你们一开始是小生物的时候，我就一直在看着你们：你频繁受挫时我也经常感到绝望，而你屡次成功时我也高兴地咆哮。现在，我发现你已经长大了，你的文明已经成熟，并准备好被委托亲子关系的终极责任了。现在是时候让你们再次奉献自己，来帮我抚养我的孩子们了。
descriptions.en: Time passes, and with it my doubts. From small beginnings have I watched you: often despairing at your frequent impetuity, and yet always roaring in delight at your successes. Now, I find that you have grown, that your civilization has matured, and is ready to be entrusted with the ultimate responsibility: parenthood. It is time for you to rededicate yourselves to rearing my children.

tooltips.en: We will be able to build §YDragon Hatcheries§! at starbases, from which we will be able to recruit up to 10 §YFledgling Dragons§!.

label.en: We thank you for this offer, but we must turn it down.

tooltips.en: The Sky Dragon will depart, never to return.

descriptions.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]观察了天龙，报告称它的内脏似乎发出了巨大的吱吱声。在过去的几个月里，它也异常频繁地在[Root.GetName]周围盘旋，有时会突然掠过大气层的上界，然后再次离开。我们的假设是该生物饿了，希望着陆觅食，就像它过去定期做的那样。不清楚它为什么会犹豫——既然我们已经加入了群星大家庭，也许它想看看我们将如何反应。
descriptions.en: Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] observing the Sky Dragon have reported loud creaking noises seemingly coming from its internal organs. It has also been circling around [Root.GetName] unusually often over the last few months, sometimes swooping right past the upper reaches of the atmosphere before pulling away again. Our working hypothesis is that the creature is hungry and wishes to land to feed, as it has periodically done in the past. It is not clear why it hesitates - perhaps it wishes to see how we react, now that we have joined it among the stars.

label.zh: 下次它接近时，像它周围打一炮警示它。
label.en: Fire a warning shot next time it comes close.

label.zh: 在一片僻静的宇域为它腾点空间。
label.en: Set aside some space for it in a secluded area.

tooltips.zh: §R龙在星球着陆后可能会食用大量的食物！§!
tooltips.en: §RThe dragon is likely to consume a lot of food once it lands on the planet!§!

descriptions.zh: 龙并没有给我们表现出的敌意好脸色。随着一声巨响——其力量足以在半个星球的范围引发次级地震——巨龙以其冰冷的火焰袭击了[Root.GetName]上的一个人口聚集中心。
descriptions.en: The dragon did not appreciate our show of hostility. With a loud bellow - the force of which was strong enough to cause minor earthquakes across half the planet - the dragon smote a large center of population on [Root.GetName] with its icy flames.

descriptions.zh: 龙并没有给我们表现出的敌意好脸色。随着一声巨响——其力量足以在半个星球上引发次级地震——巨龙以其冰冷的火焰袭击了[Root.GetName]，摧毁了重要生产设施，并击杀了大量的子个体。
descriptions.en: The dragon did not appreciate our show of hostility. With a loud bellow - the force of which was strong enough to cause minor earthquakes across half the planet - the dragon smote [Root.GetName] with icy flames, destroying vital production facilities and killing a large number of drones.

descriptions.zh:
龙似乎意识到了我们的意图，优雅地俯冲下来，在我们腾出的区域休息。我们留下的大量食物应该有所帮助，必须说——龙在那上面以惊人地贪婪躺平了。

我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正在远处观察它。
descriptions.en:
The dragon appeared to realize our intentions, and gracefully swooped down to rest in the area we had vacated. The large supply of food we left behind probably helped, it must be said - the dragon has laid into it with astounding voracity.

Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are observing it from a distance.

descriptions.zh:
在行星上来回几次之后，这条龙显然认为可以安全着陆。尽管它选择了一个僻静的区域，但仍有一些[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被杀死，还有更多人流离失所——鉴于其令人难以置信的体型和贪婪的胃口，这并不奇怪。

它现在已经安顿下来，并以惊人的速度摧毁当地的动植物群。当地居民正与之保持距离。
descriptions.en:
After several further passes of the planet, the dragon apparently decided it was safe to land. Although it picked a secluded area, a number of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were killed and even more displaced - unsurprising, given its incredible size and voracious appetite.

It has now settled in, and is decimating the local flora and fauna at an alarming rate. The local population is keeping its distance.

descriptions.zh:
在行星上来回几次之后，这条龙显然认为可以安全着陆。尽管它选择了一个僻静的区域，但仍有一些子个体被摧毁，还有更多子个体流离失所——鉴于其令人难以置信的体型和贪婪的胃口，这并不奇怪。

它现在已经安顿下来，并以惊人的速度摧毁当地的动植物群。当地居民正与之保持距离。
descriptions.en:
After several further passes of the planet, the dragon apparently decided it was safe to land. Although it picked a secluded area, a number of our drones were destroyed and even more displaced - unsurprising, given its incredible size and voracious appetite.

It has now settled in, and is decimating the local flora and fauna at an alarming rate. Our drones are keeping a precautionary distance.

descriptions.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的丰收中饱食数年之后，现在明显更壮的天龙再次起飞。随着最后致敬的吼声，它升空了——留下了大量的鳞片、脱落的皮肤和其他因它的存在而产生的副产物。
descriptions.en: After several years of gorging itself on the bountiful harvests of [Root.GetName], the now considerably girthier Sky Dragon has once again taken flight. With a final roar in salute, it lifted off - leaving behind a large collection of scales, shed skin, and other byproducts of its presence.

label.zh: 我们应该研究这些残留物。

tooltips.zh: 这条龙现在再一次回到§Y[here_be_dragons_planet.System.GetName]§!恒星系中遨游了。
tooltips.en: The dragon now once again roams the §Y[here_be_dragons_planet.System.GetName]§! system.

tooltips.zh: 这条龙现在再一次回到§Y[here_be_dragons_planet.System.GetName]§!恒星系中遨游了。
tooltips.en: The dragon now once again roams the §Y[here_be_dragons_planet.System.GetName]§! system.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]恒星系中的舰队报告说，在恒星系内遨游的那条龙正在攻击我们的舰船！目前还不清楚它是故意加入[From.Owner.GetAdj]防御战争，还是只是因为我们侵犯了它的领土而对我们感到愤怒。可以肯定的是，如果我们打算夺取[here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]，就必须击败它！
descriptions.en: Our fleets in the [From.GetName] system report that the dragon roaming the system is attacking our ships! It is unclear whether it is deliberately joining the [From.Owner.GetAdj] defense, or if it is simply angry at us for encroaching on its territory. What is certain is that we will have to get through it if we intend to take [here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]!

options.script: name = BATTLESTATIONS

descriptions.zh: 天龙似乎不愿坐视[From.GetAdj]入侵[here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]的行动。它呼啸而起，喷吐出冰焰毁灭了敌人的舰队！
descriptions.en: The Sky Dragon seems to have taken a dim view of [From.GetAdj] efforts to invade [here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]. It soars to our defense, breathing icy destruction upon their fleets!

descriptions.zh: 天龙似乎不愿坐视[From.GetAdj]入侵[here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]的行动。它停止了在行星上进餐，腾飞而起喷吐出冰焰毁灭了敌人的舰队！
descriptions.en: The Sky Dragon seems to have taken a dim view of [From.GetAdj] efforts to invade [here_be_dragons_planet.GetName]. Ceasing its repast on the planet, it has taken flight to breathe icy destruction upon their fleets!

tooltips.zh: 这条龙现在再一次回到§Y[here_be_dragons_planet.System.GetName]§!恒星系中遨游了。
tooltips.en: The dragon now once again roams the §Y[here_be_dragons_planet.System.GetName]§! system.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
既然我们已经在理解异种生物学和异星材料方面取得了一些进展，我们的研究人员提议派出科研船对龙进行更进一步的观察。他们对龙鳞格外感兴趣，这些龙鳞十分耐用——甚至无法穿透。虽然我们已经获得了大量自然脱落的样本，我们的科学家对龙鳞如何形成仍然感到困惑。若是使用所谓的“轻微深入”探针，科学家们相信他们可以进入其保护层的下方，直接研究龙鳞的自然过程。

当然，龙不会介意的……当然如此。
descriptions.en:
Now that we have made some progress understanding xenobiology and exotic materials, our researchers have proposed that we send a science ship to take a closer look at the dragon. They are particularly interested in its scales, which are remarkably durable - even impenetrable. While we have acquired numerous naturally-shed samples, our scientists remain baffled as to how the scales form. Using what they describe as a "mildly intrusive" probe, they believe they can get under the dragon's protective layer and directly study its natural processes.

Surely the dragon will not mind... Surely.

descriptions.zh:
既然我们已经在理解异种生物学和异星材料方面取得了一些进展，我们可以考虑派出科研船对龙进行更进一步的观察。龙鳞格外引人留意，它们十分耐用——甚至无法穿透。虽然已经获得了大量自然脱落的样本，我们的科学子个体对龙鳞如何形成仍然感到困惑。若是能部署足够深入的探针，我们也许可以进入其保护层的下方，直接研究龙鳞的自然过程。

当然，龙是不会介意的……当然如此。
descriptions.en:
Now that we have made some progress understanding xenobiology and exotic materials, we may consider sending a science ship to take a closer look at the dragon. Of particular interest to us are its scales, which are remarkably durable - even impenetrable. While we have acquired numerous naturally-shed samples, our science drones remain baffled as to how the scales form. By deploying a sufficiently intrusive probe, we may be able to get inside the dragon's protective layer and directly study its natural processes.

Surely the dragon will not mind... Surely.

label.zh: 试试不那么深入的其他方法吧。

descriptions.zh:
尽管这条龙专注地看着我们的科研船，但当我们多次对其进行深度扫描时，它没有作出任何反应——以目前的技术水平，这是我们能够做到的最彻底的扫描。这些扫描使我们对龙的生物过程有了新的洞见，可是其鳞片之下的秘密仍然像以前一样难以捉摸。

虽然我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]被迫就这件事承认失败，但他们向我们保证，他们仍能把获得的知识好好加以利用。
descriptions.en:
Though the dragon watched our science vessel attentively, it did not react as we subjected it to several deep scans - the most thorough we are capable of at our current level of technology. They provided us with fresh insights into its biological processes, though the secret behind its scaly hide remains as elusive as ever.

Although our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are forced to admit defeat on that matter, they assure us that they will nonetheless be able to put the knowledge they have acquired to good use.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 龙似乎饿了。又也许它今天就是心情不好。在我们的舰船接近它的时候，这条龙呲牙低吼，§R嚼着牙§!骤然间猛冲向前，不留做出规避动作的时间。我们的科研船现在没剩多少残骸了——至少在龙的肚子之外没剩多少。
descriptions.en: It appears the dragon was hungry. Or maybe it was just having a bad day. As our vessel approached it, the dragon snarled and abruptly lunged forward in a §Rchomping§! motion, leaving no time for evasive maneuvers. Little now remains of our science vessel - outside of the dragon's belly, at least.

label.zh: 最好不要进一步激怒它。
喂了它以后现在它应该不饿了。我们再试一次。
label.en: Its hunger should be sated now. Let's try again.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 龙放任我们的科研船靠近，但随着探针发射，它用尾巴以不可思议的力量§H猛击§!舰船。值得注意的是，虽然舰船因此越过了半个恒星系，它几乎完好无损，舰上也没有报告人员伤亡。不管怎么说，龙明显不太高兴。
descriptions.en: The dragon tolerated our science ship's approach, but as the probe was launched, it used its tail to §Hswat§! our vessel out of the way with incredible force. Remarkably, although the ship was vaulted halfway across the solar system, it was almost entirely undamaged, and no casualties were reported onboard. Nonetheless, the dragon's displeasure was clear.

label.zh: 最好不要进一步激怒它。
有意思。我们应该看看再试一次会发生什么。
label.en: Fascinating. We should see what happens if we try again.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 正当我们的舰船第二次接近龙的时候，它勃然而动，鼻腔中喷射出寒光，如飞梭一般直奔[dragon_colony.GetName]！防御系统还来不及启动，它就暴怒地向这颗行星的北半球倾泻出它的寒冰之息，顷刻间摧毁了多个大型人口中心。
descriptions.en: As our vessel approached the dragon for the second time, the dragon sprang into action. Nostrils flaring, it darted away, heading directly towards [dragon_colony.GetName]! Before our defense systems could react, it furiously unleashed its icy breath upon the northern hemisphere of the planet, causing considerable damage to several large population centers.

descriptions.zh: 正当我们的舰队第二次接近龙的时候，它勃然而动，鼻腔中喷射出寒光，如飞梭一般直奔[dragon_colony.GetName]！防御系统还来不及启动，它就暴怒地向这颗行星的北半球倾泻出它的寒冰之息，顷刻间摧毁了无数关键生产设施。
descriptions.en: As our vessel approached the dragon for the second time, it sprang into action. Nostrils flaring, it darted away, heading directly towards [dragon_colony.GetName]! Before our defense systems could react, it furiously unleashed its icy breath upon the northern hemisphere of the planet, causing considerable damage to vital production facilities.

label.en: Let's back off for a while.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们的探针牢牢抓住龙，发现了它鳞片间的一个狭小缝隙并灵巧地钻了进去时，龙愤怒地低吼着。在[Root.GetName]准备强制超光速以回避被激怒的龙的时候，探针已经开始收录令人称奇的数据了。从这些数据中我们发现，其鳞片之所以如此强韧，是由于它在高速进入[dragon_colony.GetName]大气层的过程中，激活的一系列复杂的酶促反应造成的。

虽然还有许多未解之谜，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]算是弄清了一件事：由于龙体生理学的复杂性，如果我们想要获得这种鳞片的材料，唯一的办法是屠龙。尽管如此，他们还是保证已经获得的知识无论如何也是有用的。
descriptions.en:
The dragon snarled in fury as our probe latched onto it and swiftly located and burrowed into a minute gap between its scales. While the [Root.GetName] was forced to engage emergency FTL to avoid the displeased dragon, the probe was able to pick up intriguing readings. From what we can tell, the durability of the dragon's scales is the result of a complex cocktail of enzymes that trigger a unique chemical reaction when the creature enters the atmosphere of [dragon_colony.GetName] at high speeds.

Though much is left to uncover, our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are clear about one thing: due to the complexity of the dragon's biology, if we wish to gain access to the material from which its scales are made, we will have to kill it first. Nonetheless, they assure us that the knowledge they have gained will be useful, either way.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 在我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]和[This.Owner.GetLinguists]排查了所有同龙进行交互的已知记录之后，他们准备进行数项实验以测试它的反应。他们保证所有的动作都是经过了仔细的论证，一旦龙表现出哪怕是最轻微的不满，所有活动都会立刻中止。
descriptions.en: As our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] and [This.Owner.GetLinguists] trawl through the records of known interactions with the dragon, they have prepared a few experiments to test its responses. They assure us that every move is planned with due diligence, and that they will cease their activities at the slightest sign of displeasure from the dragon.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]还在为龙的发声这一科研难题在艰苦奋战。尽管他们心里抱着希望，期冀马上就能突破，然而在我们和这样一只体型庞大的太空飞龙之间寻找能够作为参考的共同框架，可能本身就存在着极大的困难，这使得这样的障碍更加不可逾越。

这可能会造成沮丧的气氛，尽管这并不是源于龙的行为本身：它对于我们的科研船闯入它的领域展现出了惊人的耐心。根据它喉咙活动产生的韵律，它正不断地产生同一组声门震动——吼叫或者哭喊，显然不是对着真空的宇宙——就好像它知道我们正在做什么，还希望能够帮忙。
descriptions.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] remain stumped by the dragon's utterances. Though they are hopeful that a breakthrough is just around the corner, the difficulties inherent in finding a common frame of reference between ourselves and an enormous spacefaring dragon remain seemingly insurmountable.

This would be cause for despair, were it not for the behavior of the dragon itself: it has been remarkably patient with our research ships intruding on its space. Based on the rhythmic movements of its throat, it has been repeating the same set of glottal vibrations - roars or cries, were it not for the vacuum of space - almost as if it knows what we are doing, and wishes to help.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]报告了令人咋舌的突破。就在他们绝望地以为永远无法理解龙的时候，他们将它不断涨落的身体能量辐射转置成为了声音波形。随后他们聆听了结果，他们简直不敢相信自己的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]。毫无疑问：龙在讲我们的语言，只不过使用的是不同的媒介。它的吼叫，事实上，只是想要引起我们的注意，而不是试图进行交流。

根据已有的知识，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]重新播放了旧的记录。根据这些记录，龙在过去的吼叫是“令人失望地、孩子气般地”抱怨食物的品质和“行星上的爬行生物”们缓慢的进度。然而，这头生物现在表现出极大的惊讶和喜悦，因为我们能够理解它。事实上，多年以来它表现出来的好意都被我们漏掉了。显然它希望同我们对话，这可是一件至关重要的大事，但是必须在我们已经§S“准备好了”§!之后才行。
descriptions.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] report an astounding breakthrough. Despairing at ever being able to understand the dragon, they transposed the spectral map of its fluctuating corporal energy emissions to acoustic waveforms. As they listened to the results, they could not believe their [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]. It was undeniable: the dragon was speaking our language, but in a different medium! Its roars were, in fact, only meant to draw our attention, rather than an attempt at communication.

Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] replayed old recordings with this knowledge in mind. According to them, the dragon's past utterances have been "disappointingly puerile" grumbling about food and the slow progress of the "planet crawlers." Nevertheless, the creature now expresses surprise and pleasure that we are able to understand it. Indeed, it displays an alacrity not seen for many years. Apparently it has a matter of great importance that it wishes to speak with us about, but only when we are §S"ready."§!

descriptions.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]报告了令人咋舌的突破。就在他们绝望地以为永远无法理解龙的时候，他们将它不断涨落的身体能量辐射转置成为了标准波形偏差图。结果表明它实际上在用简单的二进制代码“说话”，并且和我们平常使用的相差不大，只不过使用的波长不一样。它的吼叫，事实上，只是想要引起我们的注意，而不是试图进行交流。

根据已有的知识，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]重新播放了旧的记录。根据这些记录，龙在过去的吼叫是“令人失望地、孩子气般地”抱怨食物的品质和“行星上的爬行生物”们缓慢的进度。然而，这头生物现在表现出极大的惊讶和喜悦，因为我们能够理解它。事实上，多年以来它表现出来的好意都被我们漏掉了。显然它希望同我们对话，这可是一件至关重要的大事，但是必须在我们已经§S“准备好了”§!之后才行。
descriptions.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] report an astounding breakthrough. Despairing at ever coming to understand the dragon, they transposed the spectral map of its fluctuating corporal energy emissions into a standard wave deviation graph. This revealed that it was in fact "speaking" in simple binary code, not dissimilar to that which we sometimes use, just on a different wavelength. Its roars were, in fact, only meant to draw our attention, rather than an attempt at communication.

Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] replayed old recordings with this knowledge in mind. According to them, the dragon's past utterances have been "disappointingly puerile" grumbling about food and the slow progress of the "planet crawlers." Nevertheless, the creature now expresses surprise and pleasure that we are able to understand it. Indeed, it displays an alacrity not seen for many years. Apparently it has a matter of great importance that it wishes to speak with us about, but only when we are §S"ready."§!

label.zh: 但是我们已经准备好了！

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 龙发表了一段冗长的谩骂，谈及了它在数个纪元积累的智慧，以及它观察我们对时间和使命的态度——甚至都懒得提我们对宇宙的基础那肤浅得可悲的理解。很明显它认为我们太年轻，太单纯，太鲁莽，在现阶段还配不上这个任务。
descriptions.en: The dragon launches into a lengthy diatribe about the wisdom it has accumulated over the eons, and its observations regarding our attitude toward time and commitments - not to mention our still-pitiful knowledge of the fundamentals of the universe. Apparently it considers us young and reckless, and unworthy of this quest at present.

label.zh: 哎呀。我们得奋斗，不能躺了。
label.en: Alas. We shall strive to be better.

descriptions.zh: 我们不太清楚哪里出了差错，但是我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]看上去引得龙颜大怒。一声威震天穹的怒吼之后，这头生物将致命的龙息倾泻在他们的舰船之上，杀死了[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]——同时给我们试图理解它的工作造成了重大的挫折。
descriptions.en: We are not quite sure what went wrong, but our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] seem to have displeased the dragon. With a mighty roar, the creature unleashed its deadly breath upon their vessel, killing [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] - and setting us back considerably in our attempt to understand it.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
[This.GetName]汇报在[From.GetName]星系目击了一条骇人的太空巨龙！

这个恒星系似乎是[From.Owner.GetName]的中心，其中一颗行星显示出拥有稠密人口的痕迹。

目前为止，这条龙还没对我们采取行动，也没有与这个恒星系中的另一群居民存在冲突的迹象。也许我们最好还是别管他们吧。
descriptions.en:
The [This.GetName] reports sighting a terrifying space dragon in the [From.GetName] system!

The system also appears to be a center of the [From.Owner.GetName], with one of the planets in the system showing signs of particularly dense population.

So far, the dragon has not reacted to us, nor is there any sign of conflict between it and the other inhabitants of the system. Perhaps it would be best to leave it be.
